text:
deploy-bot: Kicking off release/2026-03-22/llm-route-alpha. Planned FF changes: enable llm_route_alpha 2% -> 50% over 30m (jitter TTL 30s), pin version v2.2.0-beta for canary. Canary regions: ap-south-1, us-west-2. Will post checks and heartbeats. :rocket:
samir: Copy. I'll monitor p95/p99, error delta, and pod restart events. Add me to pager if CPU>75% for 4m.
leah: Note: v2.2.0-beta had a docker image diff vs v2.1 that caused a metric label rename in QA (metrics.llm.ctx_len -> metrics.llm.context_len). If we see missing metrics, that's likely the cause.
marco: Reminder: quiet window today 00:00-06:00 UTC. Any rollback in that window requires @sre-lead signoff.
oncall-bot: Alerting subscriptions: #eng-sre, #incidents. Paging rules active.
deply-bot: Canary toggle queued: `ffctl toggle set --flag llm_route_alpha --pct 2 --regions ap-south-1,us-west-2 --meta "canary-start"`
ops-runner: Acknowledged. Will hold `version.pin` until stable 8m. Heartbeat every 3m. If HPA scales >1x in <8m we pause ramp.
deply-bot: Canary at 2% at 1768351260. Telemetry snapshot: p95 +4ms, p99 +12ms, error-rate delta +0.08%. No restarts.
samir: p99 spike correlates with long-context requests. Sending sample request ids to thread.
leah: Running smoke evals now. If accuracy regressions >0.5% on rerank set, we revert.
deply-bot: Ramp command: `ffctl ramp --flag llm_route_alpha --to 20 --step 10m --by 9` executed. Next checkpoint in 10m.
oncall-bot: Watch: autoscaler threshold is 70% CPU across pods for 6m to trigger extra replicas.
ops-runner: Seeing a single scale-up in ap-south-1 at +7m. Noted. Holding further ramp until 10m stable.
deply-bot: At 1768351500 telemetry: ap-south-1 CPU climbed 78% sustained 5m, HPA scaled. Error delta 0.35% sustained 3m.
samir: Agree this is above our soft threshold. Recommend pause and partial rollback to 10% while we investigate.
leah: Can we pin traffic to us-west-2 at 15% and leave ap-south-1 at 5%? We want to limit blast radius.
marco: Ops: we have a pre-approved pinback procedure: set regions filter + reduce pct, then unpin version if instability continues.
ops-runner: Executing partial pinback: `ffctl set --flag llm_route_alpha --regions us-west-2 --pct 15` and `ffctl set --flag llm_route_alpha --regions ap-south-1 --pct 5`. Also setting `version.pin=locked` for canary in us-west-2 only.
deply-bot: Partial pinback applied at 1768351560. Telemetry after change: ap-south-1 CPU falling to 64% after scaling cooldown, error delta improved to 0.12%.
samir: Good improvement. Marking this hold window for 20m. Please collect JVM heap/dump if restarts >1.
leah: Smoke evals green for us-west-2. Small regression seen on long-context rerank in ap-south-1.
ops-runner: Opening follow-up INF-4829 with pod logs, HPA events, and sample req ids. Ticket created.
marco: We'll avoid a full rollback for now. Re-schedule a canary re-run after metric label patch and a small memory config tweak.
leah: I'll update the release notes draft: add "partial holdback in ap-south-1 due to autoscaler activity; follow-up fix planned."
oncall-bot: Reminder: if we decide to fully rollback, use `ffctl rollback --flag llm_route_alpha --to 0 --unpin` and notify #incidents.
deply-bot: Heartbeat scheduled every 3m. Next automated checkpoint at 1768351620.
samir: Thanks team. We'll reconvene on-thread if anything changes. :eyes:
ops-runner: Closing operational actions for now; will attach memory profiles and HPA graphs to INF-4829.
marco: Thread closed for now. Re-schedule next canary attempt after the fix and metric reconciliation. :thumbsup:
